newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures end softer in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures end softer in dull trade.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures ended softer on Monday, with most players staying on the sidelines following a poor performance in London on Friday, traders said.
"It was very quiet," said one trader. "Aluminium was left behind in London. People also want to see what the Denver summit will bring."
The TOCOM benchmark April 1998 contract lost 0.8 yen to 189.5 yen per kilo, while others shed 1.5 yen to 2.5 yen. Estimated volume was a thin 1,078 lots.

In London on Friday, benchmark three-month aluminium fell $29 to $1,586 per tonne, pressured by heavy cash selling, while copper, nickel and zinc put in a strong performance. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-6179
